visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with short blonde hair wearing a bright pink oversized sweater and brown checkered pajama pants stands in the center of a spacious, modern living room with warm ambient lighting. Several friends and a small child are seated on light gray sectional sofas and bean bags, surrounding a white oval coffee table cluttered with drinks and snacks. The scene is festive with digital confetti overlays appearing on screen. (2) The blonde person kneels on the floor facing a small child in a pink long-sleeved shirt who is held by a woman on a sofa. The blonde person holds a small red rectangular object in their hands, gesturing towards the child. The child has her hands pressed together in a greeting motion while smiling and moving her mouth as if speaking. (3) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the blonde person interacting with a young man wearing a black shirt who is lying on a white bean bag on the floor. The blonde person hands another red rectangular object to him while laughing. The young man reaches out with both hands to accept the object, smiling widely at the camera. (4) The blonde person moves toward a woman sitting at a dining table in the background. The woman is wearing a dark gray sweater and glasses. She covers her face with her hands while laughing, then reaches out to take a red envelope from the blonde person. The background shows a modern kitchen area with white cabinets. (5) In a wide group shot, everyone in the living room is now holding a red rectangular object. They are all looking toward the camera, some waving the objects and others making 'V' signs with their hands. The blonde person stands in the front, gesturing excitedly with their arms wide open as digital fireworks effects fill the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal male voice shouts excitedly with a bright, projected tone. This is accompanied by the sudden start of an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring prominent synth leads and a driving 4/4 beat. Ambient sounds of distant laughter and collective room chatter are audible underneath the main speech. (2) A soft metallic 'ding' sound effect triggers as the speaker addresses a child. The child's voice is heard speaking with clear articulation and high pitch. A canned laughter track sound effect plays briefly in response to the child's words. (3) Sound of multiple people laughing simultaneously at a moderate volume. The main male voice continues at a high speed, interacting with different friends. A 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs between cuts as the BGM maintains its steady rhythmic pulse. (4) A comic 'boing' sound effect plays as a woman is seen laughing. The main male voice uses a tease/sarcastic tone, rising in pitch at the end of sentences. There is the subtle acoustic texture of paper envelopes being handled and passed around. (5) The BGM swells slightly in volume as the entire group cheers in unison with high vocal arousal. The music ends with a final percussive hit and a slight reverb tail as the various voices fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Sequential Interaction -> Group Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a lively and humorous celebration of the Lunar New Year among a group of friends. The central figure uses the tradition of giving red envelopes (Hongbao) as a comedic framework, requiring guests to come up with clever puns involving the word 'snake' (corresponding to the Year of the Snake) before receiving their gift. It aims to share festive joy and showcase the group's close, playful dynamic.
